s2_de_lda.paired_dz_definition: Mean paired BA difference divided by sample SD of paired differences (ddof=1); null if SD is zero.
s2_de_lda.interpretation: Exploratory conditional descriptive interval for these predictions; overlapping LOSO training sets are not independent experiments. It is not a confirmatory population interval and does not adjust for comparing multiple variants.
